title: I-007 MakeCompound persist with external-link include-or-unlink
clauseOfficialized: MakeCompound persists a child sequence and a pinned nest clip. Selected starts are rebased; interior holes are explicit Gaps; neighbors stay on the parent. An incomplete AV link is COMPOUND_EXTERNAL_LINK and does not half-write. Unlink first allows compounding only the video. Including every member keeps preserve sync on the parent nest pair. A locked track is FIELD_LOCKED. Depth greater than 8 is NEST_DEPTH. Optical-flow interpolation stays refused.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: Increment 2.24 officialized RetimeMap and NestResolver only. MakeCompound persist and the I-006 external-link include-or-unlink rule were still listed in I-007 remainingScope.
rowsStillOpen: I-006 remainingScope (轨锁/syncLock/link/unlink/多轨边界; field-aware invert of Slip/Roll/Slide)
